features.description: Project scaffold: MV3 manifest, package.json with zero-dependency test runner (node:test), README skeleton, .gitignore
steps: manifest.json is valid MV3 with name, version, content_scripts matching https://www.youtube.com/* and a test asserts these fields
package.json has the only version declaration; manifest version is checked by a test to equal it
`npm test` runs and passes with no network or browser
README states what it does, how to load the unpacked extension, how to run tests

features.description: Pure ad detector module: given a DOM (document), decide whether a YouTube video ad is currently playing
steps: Returns true for a DOM fixture where #movie_player has class ad-showing
Returns true for a fixture containing .ytp-ad-player-overlay or .video-ads .ad-interstitial
Returns false for a fixture of a normal video, and for a page with no player
Tests run against jsdom-free HTML fixtures or a minimal DOM stub (decide in-session, keep dependencies minimal)

features.description: Retry policy module: decides whether to reload, tracking attempts per video id with a cap and delay
steps: First ad detection on a video returns {reload: true} and increments the stored counter
After max attempts (default 10) returns {reload: false, reason: 'limit'}
Counter resets when the video id changes or an ad-free state is confirmed
Reload delay is configurable and never below a minimum (e.g. 500 ms) to avoid a tight reload loop
Storage is injected (sessionStorage-like object) so tests use an in-memory fake

features.description: Content script wiring: observe the player, on ad detection call location.reload() per the retry policy until no ad is present
steps: With injected fakes, ad detected -> reload called once after the delay
No ad within a settle window -> counter reset and no reload
Ad still present after cap -> no further reload and a console message explains why
Only active on watch pages (/watch), not on home, search or Shorts
Detection uses MutationObserver on the player, not a polling busy loop

features.description: SPA navigation handling: re-arm the logic when YouTube navigates between videos without a full page load
steps: A yt-navigate-finish event re-initialises detection for the new video id
Counter for the previous video does not leak into the new one
Listener is removed/not duplicated on repeated init (tested with a fake event target)

features.description: Popup and options: enable/disable toggle, max attempts and delay, stored in chrome.storage.sync
steps: Settings module returns defaults when storage is empty and validates out-of-range values (clamps or rejects)
Content script reads the settings and honors enabled=false (no reload ever)
Popup shows the toggle state and the reload count for the current tab (storage faked in tests)
manifest declares only the permissions it needs (storage); a test asserts no extra permissions or host permissions beyond youtube.com

features.description: Packaging and docs: zip build script, CHANGELOG, README finalised, manual acceptance checklist
steps: `npm run build` produces dist/freeyt-<version>.zip containing manifest and scripts only (no tests, no node_modules); a test inspects the zip listing
CHANGELOG.md exists and its top entry matches the package version
README lists the manual real-browser acceptance checklist (load unpacked, open a video with ads, observe reloads stop, confirm cap behaviour)

questions.question: Language/tooling for the extension?
options: Plain JavaScript (ES modules) + node:test, zero dependencies

questions.question: What should happen when the ad persists after the max reload attempts?
options: Stop reloading and leave the page (show a console/badge note)
Keep reloading with growing delay (backoff), never stop
Stop and try to click the Skip button instead

questions.question: Which ads should trigger a reload?
options: Only ads that cannot be skipped
